site_blocked.title: Club website blocks Home Assistant
site_blocked.description:
{url} refused the request from Home Assistant (HTTP 403, usually bot protection). The calendar keeps showing the last schedule it read.

To load a new schedule yourself: save the schedule image to e.g. `/config/www/rooster.jpg`, add `/config/www` to `allowlist_external_dirs` in configuration.yaml and run the action `af_group_classes.refresh` with `image_path: /config/www/rooster.jpg`.

refresh.name: Check schedule
refresh.description: Check the club website for a new schedule image now. The image is only read again when it changed, unless you force it.

force.name: Read again
force.description: Read the image with AI even when it did not change.

image_path.name: Image file
image_path.description: Read this local image instead of the website (must be in allowlist_external_dirs).
